question_text: A person is going towards North. After walking 100 m, he turns to his right and walks 50 m. Again, he turns to his right & walks 100 m. Finally, he turns to his left & walks 20 m. Now in which direction is he moving or facing? (a) West/ (b) East/ (c) North/ (d) South/

A person is going towards South. After walking 200 m, he turns to his right and walks 80m. Again, he turns to his right and walks 100m. After it he turns to his left and walks 50m. Finally, he turns to his left and walks 30m. Now, in which direction is he moving? (a) South/ (b) North/ (c) East/ (d) West/

A person is going towards North-East. After walking 80 m, he turns to his right and walks 50m. After it, he turns to his left and walks 70m. Then he turns to his right and walks 40m. Again, he turns to his left and walks 20m. Finally, he turns to his left and walks 20m. Now, in which direction is he moving? (a) North/ (b) North-West/ (c) South-West/ (d) South-East/

A person is going towards North-West. After walking 80 m, he turns to his right and walks 40m. Then he turns to his left and walks 30m. Again, he turns to his left and walks 30m. After it, he turns  to his right and walks 50 m. Finally, he turns to his right and walks 40m. Now which direction is he facing? (a) South-East / (b) South-West / (c) North-West / (d) North-East /

A person is going towards North. After walking 150 m, he turns to his right and walks 80 m. Again, he turns to his right and walks 90 m. After it, he again turns to his right and walks 60m. Finally, he turns to his left and walks 40m. Now which direction is he  facing? (a) North/ (b) South/ (c) East/ (d) West/

A person is moving towards North-East. After walking 70 m, he turns to his left and walks 30m. After it, he again turns to his left and walks 50 m. Then, he turns to his right and walks 50m. Finally, he turns to his left and walks 30 m. Now which direction is he facing? (a) North-West/ (b) North-East/ (c) South-West/ (d) West/

A person turns to his right, after walking 100m towards East and walks 70m. Again, he turns to his right and walks 70m. After it, he again turns to his right and walks 30m. Finally, he turns to his right and walks 50m. Now, in which direction is he moving? (a) South/ (b) East/ (c) North/ (d) West/

A person is going towards North-East. After walking 100 m he turns to his left and walks 70 m. Again, he turns to his left and walks 70m. After it, he turns to his left and walks 50m. Finally, he again turns to his left and walks 60m. Now  which direction is he facing? (a) North-West/ (b) North-East/ (c) South-West/ (d) South-East/

A person turns to his right, after walking 80 m towards North and walks 50 m. Again he turns to his right and walks 30 m. After it, he turns to his right and walks 40 m. Now, again he turns to his right and walks 40 m. Finally he turns to his left and walks 30m. Now which direction is he facing? (a) North/ (b) South/ (c) East/ (d) West/

A person is going towards North. After walking 150 m he takes 300 times right turns and each time he walks 50 m. After it he takes 200 times left turns and each time he walks 40 m. Now which direction is he facing? (a) North/ (b) East/ (c) South/ (d) West/

One person A is going towards North-East. After walking 120 m he takes 200 times left turns and each time he walks 40 m. After  it, he takes 225 times right turn and each time he walks 40 m. Now, in which direction is he moving? A (a) North-East/ (b) North-West/ (c) South-West/ (d) South-East/

If a person turns to his right after walking 100 m  straight and walks 50 m. Again he turns to his right and walks 100 m. Finally he turns to his left and walks 20 m. Now if he is moving towards North then in which direction did he start to walk? (a) North/ (b) West/ (c) South/ (d) East/

A person starts walking in some direction. After walking 120 m he turns to his right and walks 60 m. After it he turns to his left and walks 50 m. Then he turns to his right and walks 60 m. After it, he turns to his left and walks 70 m. Finally he again turns to his left and walks 60 m. Now, if he is moving towards North-East then in which direction did he start to walk? (a) North-East/ (b) North-West/ (c) South-East/ (d) South-West/

A person turns to his right after walking 80 m straight and walks 20 m. After it, he turns to his left and walks 40 m. Again, he turns to his left and walks 50m. Finally he turns to his left and walks 40 m. If the person is moving towards South-West then in which direction did he start to walk? (a) North-East / (b) North-West / (c) South-West / (d) South-East /

A person started walking in some direction. After walking 200 m straight, he turns to his left and walks 80 m. After it he takes consecutive four right turns and each time he walks 50 m. If the person is moving towards North then in which direction did he start to walk ? (a) East/ (b) West/ (c) North/ (d) South/

A person is facing North. First, he turns 45° in clockwise direction, then he turns 90° in Anti-clockwise direction and finally he turns 135° clockwise. Now which direction is he facing? 45° 90° 135° (a) North-East/ (b) North-West/ (c) East/ (d) South/

A person is facing North-East. First, he turns 45° in clockwise. After it, he takes 3 turns 45° in clockwise. Then he turns 90° in anticlockwise and finally he again turns 90° in anticlockwise. Now which direction is he facing? 45° 45° 90° 90° (a) North-West/ (b) North-East/ (c) South-West/ (d) South-East/

A person is facing North-West. First, he turns 135° in clockwise. After it, he again turns 135° in clockwise. Then he turns 45° in anti-clockwise. Finally, he again turns 45° in anti-clockwise. Now which direction is he facing? 135° 135° 45° 45° (a) North-East / (b) North-West / (c) South-West / (d) South-East /

One person B is facing some direction. First, he turns 45° in clockwise. After it, he turns 90° in clockwise. Now, he turns 45° in anti-clockwise. Then he turns 90° in anti- clockwise. Finally he turns 45° in clockwise. Now, if he is facing North-East, then in which direction did he start to walk? B 45° 90° 45° 90° 45° (a) East/ (b) West/ (c) North/ (d) South-West/

A man is going towards East. After walking 100m, he turns to his left and walks 25m. Again he turns to his left and walks 45m and Finally, he turns to his left and walks 25m. (i) Now in which direction is he moving? (a) North/ (b) East/ (c) South/ (d) West/ (ii) Now in which direction is the person from the staring point? (a) East/ (b) North/ (c) West/ (d) South/ (iii)How far is he from the starting point? (a) 45 m (b) 25 m (c) 55 m (d) 195 m (iv)Now how far and in which direction is he from the star- ting point? (a) 45 m, West/ (b) 45 m, East/ (c) 55 m, West/ (d) 55 m, East/

A person walks 1km towards East. Then he turns to South and walks 5km. Again, he turns towards East and walks 2km and finally, he turns to North and walks 9km. Now, how far and in which direction is the person from the starting point? (a) 4 km, North-East / (b) 3 km, North-West / (c) 5 km, North-West / (d) 5 km, North-East /

A is 6 km East of B. C is 4 km North of B. D is 12 km South of C. Now how far and in which direction is D from A? A, B C, B D, C D, A (a) 10 km, North-East/ (b) 10 km, South-West/ (c) 14 km, South-West/ (d) 14 km, North-East/

A person walks 5 km. towards East. Then he turns to South and walks the same distance and finally he turns to his left and walks 7 km. How far and in which direction is he from the starting point? (a) 12 km., South-West/ (b) 13 km, South-West/ (c) 13 km., South-East/ (d) 12 km., South-East/

A person walks 1 km. towards North then he turns to his right at 45° and walks 2 km. and finally he turns to his right and walks 2 km. Now how far and in which direction is he from the starting point? 45° (a) 3 km., North-East/ (b) 5 km., North-East/ (c) 3 km., South-East/ (d) 5 km., South-East/

A person walks 5 km. towards East. Then he turns to his right at 135° and walks 5 2 km. Finally he turns to North and walks 2km., How far and in which direction is he from the starting point? 135° 5 2 (a) 3 km., West/ (b) 3 km., South/ (c) 4 km., West/ (d) 4 km., South/

Abhishek started from point P and moves 15m. in South direction and reaches point Q. Then he turns left and moves 7m. and reaches point R. Again he turns left and moves 10m. and reaches point S. From point S he turns 180° in anti-clockwise direction and then turns 270° in clockwise direction. After it, he moves 5m. straight and reaches point T. He turns 90° left and moves 5m. to reach point U and stops. P Q R S S 180° 270° T T 90° U (i) What is the shortest distance between point P and U? P U (a) 10m. (b) 12m. (c) 15m. (d) 7m. (ii) In which direction is S from P? S, P (a) North-West/ (b) North-East/ (c) South-West/ (d) South-East/

Amit started from point P. He moves 10m. in East direction and reaches point Q. Then he turns to his right and moves 7m. and reaches point R. Now, he turns to his left and moves 15m. and reaches point S. From point S he turns South-West and moves straight 17m. and reaches point T. From point T he turns towards. West and moves 10m. straight and reaches point U and stops. P Q R R S S T T U (i) What is the shortest distance between point Q and T? Q T (a) 10m. (b) 12m. (c) 15m. (d) 17m. (ii) In which direction is point P with respect to point U? U P (a) North-East/ (b) North-West/ (c) North/ (d) South/

Avni starts walking from point S to South direction. After walking 12km she reached to point W, then she turns to her right and walks 6 km. and reaches point X. Now, she again turns to her left and walks 12 km. and reaches point F where she meets Akanksha, who is coming from East direction. Now Akanksha is in which direction from point W? S W X F W (a) North-West/ (b) North-East/ (c) South-West/ (d) South-East/

Mohan started from point P. He moves 15m. in East direction and reaches point Q. Then he turns to his left and moves 7m. and reaches point R. Now, he turns to his right and moves 12m. and reaches point S. From point S he moves towards North-West and moves 13m. straight and reaches point T. Now, he moves towards West and walks 5m. and reaches point U. Then he turns 90° left and moves 8m. and stops at point V. P Q R S S T T U 90° V (i) What is the shortest distance between point T and Q? T Q (a) 5m. (b) 10m. (c) 12m. (d) 13m. (ii) In which direction is point P with respect to point R? R P (a) North-West/ (b) South-West/ (c) South/ (d) North/

If South-East becomes South-West; South-West becomes North-West and so on then what will South become? (a) West/ (b) East/ (c) South-West/ (d) South-East/

It is 3'0 clock and if at this time, the minute hand points towards North-East, then in which direction will the hour hand be? (a) South-West/ (b) South/ (c) South-East/ (d) North-East/
It is 9'0 clock. If at this time, the minute hand points towards North-West, then in which direction will the hour hand be? (a) South/ (b) West/ (c) North-West/ (d) South-West/
It is 4:30. At this time, the hour hand points towards South-West, then in which direction will the minute hand be? (a) South-West/ (b) South-East/ (c) West/ (d) East/
It is 10:30. If at this time, the hour hand is pointing towards North, then in which direction will the hour hand be at 1:30? (a) North-West/ (b) South/ (c) East/ (d) West/

In morning, a person was performing yoga with his head down and legs up. If at this time his face is towards west, then in which direction will his left hand be? (a) South/ (b) North/ (c) North-East/ (d) South-East/

In morning, a person was performing yoga with his head down and legs up. If at this time his face is towards South, then in which direction will his right hand be? (a) East/ (b) West/ (c) North-West/ (d) South-West/

One morning two friends Sumit and Mohit were talking to each other face to face. If at this time the shadow of Sumit fell exactly to his backside, then which direction was Sumit facing? (a) North/ (b) East/ (c) South/ (d) West/
